one_liner: Coda has a free, broad REST API v1 with personal API tokens and an official hosted MCP server (OAuth2 PKCE); highly buildable.
auth_notes: REST API uses user-generated personal API tokens (bearer). OAuth2 PKCE is documented for the official MCP server only (mcp:all scope); no clearly documented OAuth2 for the REST API for third-party apps in the evidence, so API_KEY is primary.
access_notes: The API is free in free and paid workspaces; tokens are generated from account settings. Rate limits are not plan-dependent. MCP free plans have a small request quota.
blocker_notes: Minor: the doc-creation endpoint requires Doc Maker role; rate limits are modest (writes 10 per 6s).
